evidence: Fixed mass and dimensions. No growth integration; alternative drag expressions are diagnostic, not accepted model changes.

modes.span_width: Reported full equatorial span replaces volume-equivalent cylinder width.
modes.paper_cylinder_span: Original Best-number expression and actual span, cylinder only.
modes.paper_prism_mean: Original Best number and prolate branch projected side area (3/pi)*width*length, averaging hexagonal azimuth.
modes.paper_prism_min: Same, with minimum hexagonal projected width sqrt(3)/2 times corner span.
modes.paper_prism_max: Same, with maximum hexagonal projected width equal to corner span.

author_helper_identity.scope: Both archived branches are evaluated. The prolate interpolation differs from the pinned native source; neither implementation is empirical validation.
